items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Erskine Hawkins and all them bands are waiting...

ctx.x: So there's Benny Carter smiling at you his approval... If Benny Carter gives you the stamp, and you stay with Benny Carter, you could play with anybody. Because Fletcher and all of them... They'd get scared, see. Because they're going to have a battle of music up at the Savoy or somewhere, and Erskine Hawkins and all them bands are waiting...
